title: In-Weight FPGA: Compiling Multi-Step Dialectical State Machines into Dormant Transformer Neurons via Zero-KV-Drift Closed-Form Linear Algebra
description: Closed-form Weight Space Programming (WSP) framework that compiles cross-context attention routing, multi-domain Guard-Nullspace SwiGLU verification circuits, and terminal-layer Zero-KV-Drift DAG finite state machines directly into ~0.035% of dormant Transformer parameters without gradient descent or inference scaffolding, outperforming reinforcement learning (SelfD-RL, arXiv:2611.17563) across 3,780 adversarial dialogues on Qwen3-8B and Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.
